_comment: Project configuration for the agent lanes (Release Manager + Feature + Bugfix).
Everything project-specific lives here; the scripts, hooks and skills read it.
See .claude/skills/_shared/agent-protocol.md and the README section 'Running the agent lanes'.
Commands are run with `bash -c` from the repo root. Placeholders substituted before running:
{sha}  full 40-char commit SHA being deployed (validated as hex first)
{env}  environment name from environments[].name
{since_minutes}  log window, for logs commands
Placeholders are only ever replaced with validated values, never with free text.
health must print JSON with a git_commit field (or a bare 40-char SHA) naming the SHA
that is actually running — the ladder verifies deploys by content, never by label.
After a deploy, health is polled every verifyIntervalSeconds for up to
verifyTimeoutSeconds (0 = one check), for deploys that return before rollout ends.
logs exits non-zero = failed capture; write `... | grep x || true` if no match is valid.
logs must print raw log lines to stdout; scripts/dev/board/log-triage.py redacts them
in code before anything is stored or printed. No model reads raw logs.
Never put `make -n` / `--dry-run` / `--just-print` in a deploy or rollback command:
make still executes $(MAKE) recipe lines under -n. `lanes-config.sh check` refuses it.
Review-agent model pins (architect, planner, judge, ci-triage...) live in
.claude/agent-models.json, not here. `models` below is what the lane sessions pass as
`model:` when they spawn general-purpose subagents.

claims._comment: Stale-claim reclaim (board.sh list --stale / reclaim). ttlHours: 0 disables the whole check. keepLabel opts a single issue out.

intake._comment: Issues carrying any of these labels are never announced as NEW-ISSUE work (locks, meta or tracking issues).

checks._comment: Check names whose latest run on the head may be CANCELLED by design (e.g. a job that cancels itself). Any other CANCELLED latest run is NOT a pass.

prCheck._comment: Extra offline gates `make pr-check` runs after the delivery-contract and branch-name checks. Each is a command run from the PR worktree; non-zero fails the check.

deploy._boundComment: Path prefixes whose change needs a deploy to take effect. A merged PR touching one gets the needs-deploy label.

projectBoard._comment: Optional GitHub Projects (v2) mirror of the labels, titled boardTitle. Empty owner = this repo's owner.
